change.title: stripe-node v23.0.0 (pins 2026-09-30.endive) drops Node 18, removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification and ErrorType export, removes V1-only fields from Stripe.V2List, and changes many types

source.quote: Drop support for Node.js 18. Node.js 20 is now the minimum supported version.

callSites.notes: Client lazily built in getStripe (line 15); stripe export is a getter proxy. Saves customer.id.

Verifies stripe-signature via constructWebhookEvent (lib/billing/stripe.ts:252); idempotency via stripeEvent table. Handles checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed.

task.notes: The repo uses the stripe npm SDK at 20.0.0. v23.0.0 is a breaking major: it drops Node 18, removes some exports, changes types, and pins the Endive API version. The repo is not on v23, so nothing breaks today. Upgrading, for example through a dependency bump, would require handling the type changes and the apiVersion pin change. The migration agent should check whether error handling imports ErrorType or Stripe.errors types, and confirm the Node runtime is 20 or later.
